name: Bridgetown Natural Foods
old_description: founded to provide better products and service to the natural foods community.
about:
Bridgetown Natural Foods operates from its headquarters in Portland, Oregon, and a second facility in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee. The company was founded by Kelly Klock and Dan Klock after Kelly, while building a national granola brand, struggled to find a manufacturing partner that could meet her high standards for food quality. They established Bridgetown to provide better products and service to the natural foods community. Although the exact founding year is not disclosed, the company achieved B Corporation certification in 2014, indicating it was operational by that time.

Bridgetown designs and manufactures portable natural food snacks, offering product development, production support, and scalable supply chain solutions. The company runs production lines at both locations, with a 2026 expansion in Tennessee adding a new line and creating 237 jobs. Its output focuses on organic and plant-based foods, serving both entrepreneurial and established brands.

The company partners with leading natural, gluten-free, and organic brands, providing contract manufacturing and co-packing services that enable those brands to scale. Its customer base includes innovative product creators and established companies in the natural foods sector that share a commitment to quality ingredients.

Bridgetown differentiates itself through a mission-driven approach summarized by the slogan "We Make the Food We Want Our Families to Eat." As one of the first manufacturers to certify as a B Corporation, it undergoes a rigorous social responsibility audit every three years, measuring performance against environmental, social, and community impact goals. The company emphasizes a culture of humble, conscientious problem-solvers and invests in employee growth, with examples of team members advancing from production roles to leadership positions.
